feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. The candidate is the iteration 6 design: five 16 mm sensors at x = -0.03 to +0.03 m, y = 0.06 m, weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], kp 4.0, ki 0.05, kd 1.0, base_speed 1.5, mass 0.40 kg, last_direction line loss. Iteration 6 scored 937.1, the best raced so far, with 60/60 finishes (oval 944.7, s-bend 940.9, slalom 925.7 with 0.65 line-loss events). No change is proposed to the geometry or gains, so the candidate is at least as good as the best raced design. The nearby tests did not beat it: iteration 8 (kd 0.9) fell to 865.3 with slalom at 13/20, iteration 7 (y 0.07, kd 1.1) scored 930.9, and iteration 9 (kd 1.1 at y 0.06) scored 925.9. Iteration 9 cut slalom line-loss events to about 0.4 but raised oval line-loss events to 0.9 and slightly worsened slalom max_error and steering_oscillation, so it is a near-tie rather than an improvement. Kp stays at 4.0, since iteration 4 (kp 6) collapsed the oval and s-bend and iteration 2 (kp 4.5) lost completions. Mass is at its 0.40 kg floor, and the 0.06 m off-track floor binds, so body_width cannot widen the limit. Approving now is right: further revision would cost two action runs for a small expected gain, and a race of this design gives the reference numbers for the final iteration. Plan the next revision from the race telemetry. If the race reproduces about 937 with 60/60 finishes, the remaining lever is speed. Slalom mean finish is about 2.92 s against the 3.0 s limit, and each second is worth about 20 points, so test base_speed in small steps. If slalom completion drops or max_error rises above 0.021, revert to the same design (this is the fallback). Do not change kp.
requested_changes: If the race reproduces about 937 with 60/60 finishes and slalom completion_time stays near 2.9 s, set controller.base_speed to 1.55 with all other fields unchanged. Basis: iteration 6 slalom mean finish was 2.92 s, and iteration 0 showed the oval finishing near 1.9 s at base_speed 1.6, so there is time margin to gain.

If base_speed 1.55 or any speed increase causes any slalom off-track exit, or raises slalom line_loss_events above 0.65, keep base_speed at 1.5 and submit this iteration 6 design as the final candidate. Basis: iteration 6 is the best measured design, and slalom line loss costs about 15 points per event.

Do not raise controller.kp above 4.0 or change geometry.mass below 0.40. Basis: iteration 4 (kp 6.0) collapsed oval and s-bend to 9/20 and 0/20, iteration 2 (kp 4.5) lost completions, and mass is already at its contract floor of 0.40 kg.
